seo.description: Residential construction, housing programmes and villa delivery by Igloo Construction across Algiers and Algeria.
seo.socialTitle: Residential Construction in Algeria | Igloo Construction
seo.socialDescription: Housing, villas and mixed-use residential delivery grounded in completed Algerian projects.

content.heading: Housing and villas delivered with site discipline.
content.lead: Igloo Construction works across housing programmes, villas and residential environments, coordinating structure, secondary works, access and networks around the lived result.
paragraphs: Our residential experience includes the 300/500 housing programme in Douaouda, public housing in Sidi Abdallah and villa programmes in Staoueli.
Each project is approached as a complete site: the building, the interfaces around it and the practical infrastructure that makes the development work.
